node.title: Re: Splitting in while loop
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The usual "don't use a regex when a real parser exists" applies here too. Single quotes are technically a valid character in email addresses, as are commas and spaces when quoted. The following uses [mod://Email::Address] to correctly parse and split such (admittedly very unusual and [https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5321#page-42|not recommended]) addresses.

use warnings; use strict; use Email::Address; while () { for my $addr (Email::Address->parse($_)) { print $addr->address, "\n"; } } __DATA__ 'me'@here.com, "West, Casey" "those,foo"@there.com others@there.com you@there.com,them@there.com "Hello, World"@example.com

Outputs:

'me'@here.com casey@localhost "those,foo"@there.com others@there.com you@there.com them@there.com "Hello, World"@example.com
